message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Wild Draw Four, the next player draws four cards and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first turn goes to the player to the left of the dealer. The direction of play can change with Reverse cards. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color**, the **number**, or the **action** of the top card on the discard pile. Wild cards can be played at any time. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the direction of play.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Uno** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still in opponents’ hands: number cards = face value, action cards = 20 points, Wild cards = 50 points. | | **Winning the Game** | The first player to reach the agreed‑upon score (usually 500) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the current color** – Even if a Wild was played, the next player must match that color unless they play another Wild. 2. **Use Draw Two/Draw Four strategically** – Save them for when you’re about to win or to block a strong opponent. 3. **Watch for Uno** – If you’re the last card, shout “UNO!” or risk drawing two cards. 4. **Challenge Wild Draw Four** – If you suspect the previous player had a playable card, you can challenge. If they were right, you draw four cards; if they were wrong, you draw six cards. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
